DK29.8A is a specific medical diagnosis code representing acute bleeding duodenitis. Within the context of the Danish healthcare system's quality monitoring, this code plays a targeted role in tracking patient safety and outcomes for individuals diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]]. Specifically, it is utilized as part of a broader clinical indicator designed to measure the incidence of severe bleeding events among this patient population [^src1].

Because patients with atrial fibrillation are often prescribed anticoagulant medications, monitoring bleeding complications is a critical aspect of clinical quality development. To capture these events accurately, the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database employs a wide array of ICD-10-DK diagnosis codes. DK29.8A is grouped alongside other gastrointestinal bleeding codes, such as [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] and [[dk92-2|DK92.2]], to comprehensively identify gastrointestinal hemorrhages [^src1]. This methodology is consistently documented across multiple annual reports from the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), including the 2023 and 2024 publications [^src1] [^src2].

## Claims
- For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31)
